**About Us**

Founded in 2019, LEOR is a premium skin, hair and body clinic in Pune, with centres in Koregaon Park and Aundh. We believe beauty lies in the radiance, not in fairness and that the smallest details shape the experience. Every treatment is delivered with world-class technology and highly-skilled doctors, uncompromising on quality and safety. As a Receptionist at LEOR Clinic, you will be the first point of contact for every client, at the desk and on the phone. You will welcome clients, manage the appointment book and keep the front desk running smoothly, so that every visit begins and ends to the standard of the clinical work.

* Greet every client on arrival, check them in and make them comfortable while they wait.

* Coordinate schedules between clients, doctors and the technical team so that every visit runs to time.

* Resolve routine queries at the desk and escalate concerns to the centre manager or doctor without delay.

* Maintain accurate client details and appointment records in the clinic CRM.
* Support billing and payment collection at checkout, accurately and on time.
* Report daily on footfall, appointments, no-shows and collections.

**Qualifications**

* Graduate in any discipline. A qualification in hospitality or front office management is an advantage.
* Minimum 1 year of experience at a front desk or reception, preferably in aesthetics, healthcare, wellness, luxury retail or hospitality.

**Required Skills**

* A well-groomed, polished presence and genuine warmth with every client.
* Excellent communication in English and Hindi, Marathi preferred.
* Calm and organised under pressure, able to manage calls, walk-ins and schedules at the same time.
* Comfort with appointment, billing and CRM software. Experience with Zenoti is an advantage.
* Punctual and reliable, with a strong eye for detail.

**Why LEOR Clinic**

* A premium environment where the client experience is treated as seriously as the clinical outcome.
* A wide portfolio of advanced treatments and a strong medical team to learn from.
* Growth into client relations and centre operations roles for those who deliver.

title: System Administrator
description:
CTI has been a leading AV provider for over 35 years. Since we began in 1988, our mission has been simple: to provide a fantastic customer experience.

At CTI, our biggest asset is our people, and we know that sometimes the most awesome employees don’t fit the typical mold. If you are hardworking, friendly, and know the importance of fantastic customer service, you could be a good fit at CTI. We have developed a collaborative and lively working environment, where the best and the brightest show up to work each day ready to have fun and employ their passion for and knowledge of technology in everything they do. This creative atmosphere helps us apply and share our skills with our clients, who seek quality, high-end AV and Conference Solutions.

**So, what are we looking for?**

We are looking for a System Administrator in Pune whose attitude, skills, and work ethic will embody our mission “to provide a fantastic customer experience”. you’ll help maintain, support, and improve the systems and technology services that CTI employees rely on every day. You’ll also serve as an escalation resource for more complex technical issues and work closely with the Helpdesk, Networking, Cybersecurity, and other teams to keep our technology reliable, secure, and effective.

We’re looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates clearly, documents their work, and enjoys solving problems. CTI employees are known as customer-focused problem-solvers who can get the job done and do it with a great attitude.

***What are your responsibilities?***

These responsibilities give an idea not a full picture of what you’ll do, as we work to embrace and capitalize on our employees’ strengths:

* **Systems Administration:** Maintain, monitor, troubleshoot, and support company systems, infrastructure, and business technology services.
* **Backend Systems Management:** Manage and maintain backend systems, servers, and related infrastructure to ensure system stability, availability, and performance.
* **User & Access Administration:** Manage user accounts, permissions, access, and related administrative requests while following established security practices.
* **Escalated Technical Support:** Serve as an escalation point for complex issues that require deeper troubleshooting beyond Level 1 support.
* **System Maintenance:** Assist with system updates, patching, upgrades, deployments, and ongoing lifecycle management.
* **Backup & Recovery Management:** Monitor and manage system and data backups, verify backup completion, troubleshoot backup failures, and assist with data restoration and recovery when needed.
* **Monitoring & Reliability:** Monitor system health, availability, and performance, and respond appropriately to issues to maintain reliable IT services.
* **Security Support:** Work with Cybersecurity and other IT team members to address vulnerabilities, access concerns, and security-related improvements.
* **Troubleshooting & Problem Solving:** Identify root causes, resolve recurring issues, and develop long-term solutions instead of relying solely on temporary fixes.
* **Projects & Improvements:** Participate in technology upgrades, migrations, deployments, and other IT projects.
* **Documentation:** Create and maintain technical documentation, procedures, and knowledge articles so information can be shared across the IT team.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with Helpdesk, Networking, Cybersecurity, vendors, and business teams to resolve issues and improve the employee technology experience.
* **Other Duties:** Perform other tasks as assigned.

***Will you fit in?***

* Our employees fearlessly embrace the company culture and applicants who merely want to punch in their timecards everyday are not what we are looking for.
* You can work independently with minimal guidance but aren’t afraid to ask the right questions when you need help.
* You are passionate about learning and sharing knowledge with your team to improve the entire team.
* You enjoy troubleshooting and finding better ways to solve recurring problems.
* Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical employees.
* Understand that great IT support is about both technology and customer experience.
* Are organized, dependable, and able to manage multiple priorities.
* Are willing to jump in and help wherever needed to support the team.

***Does experience count?***

* 3+ years of experience in systems administration, infrastructure support, or a similar IT role.
* Experience administering and supporting enterprise business systems, backend infrastructure, and user environments.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across operating systems, applications, user access, endpoints, and network connectivity.
* Working knowledge of networking, identity and access management, system security, data backups, recovery procedures, and general infrastructure concepts.
* Experience supporting system updates, patching, maintenance, and technology deployments.
* Experience monitoring and managing system backups and assisting with data restoration and recovery when needed.
* Strong documentation and organizational skills.
* A strong customer service mindset with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and take ownership of issues through completion.

The Senior IT Security Administrator plays a critical role in shaping the future of identity security at Advanced Energy. This position offers the opportunity to lead enterprise-wide IAM initiatives, influence Zero Trust and AI Security strategy, and modernize identity controls across global cloud and SaaS environments. Working alongside security, infrastructure, and business leaders, you will drive solutions that protect the business while enabling growth and innovation. * **IAM Administration**

* Establish scalable identity solutions that support cloud-first and hybrid environments.
* Evaluate emerging IAM technologies and industry best practices to strengthen the organization's security posture.
  

* **Identity Governance & Access Management**

* Lead initiatives related to Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), Access Management, AI Security, Identity Threat Detection and Response (ITDR), and Zero Trust security programs.

* Develop and maintain authorization models including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC), and Policy-Based Access Control (PBAC).

* **Authentication & Directory Services**

* Configure Identity Protection policies, Conditional Access policies, risk-based authentication controls, and adaptive access capabilities.
* Design and maintain integrations between identity platforms, cloud services, and business applications through APIs, provisioning connectors, and automation frameworks.
  

* **Cloud & Application Integration**

* Implement secure identity integrations with enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, and cloud environments including Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform.
* Partner with application owners and development teams to ensure secure authentication and authorization controls are implemented consistently across platforms.
* Support application onboarding, federation, provisioning, and access governance activities.
  

* **Automation & Operational Excellence**

* Develop automation solutions using PowerShell, Python, SQL, Power Automate, or similar technologies to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, operational procedures, and support runbooks.
* Recommend and implement process improvements that enhance security, user experience, and operational effectiveness.

* Lead technical projects from planning and design through deployment and operational transition.
* Mentor junior employees and provide technical guidance across IAM-related initiatives.
* Support audit, compliance, and regulatory activities by implementing appropriate controls and providing required evidence.

* Stay informed of emerging IAM threats, technologies, and industry trends.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

* Strong understanding of modern identity security concepts, including Zero Trust, least privilege, adaptive authentication, attribute and risk-based access controls, continuous access evaluation, and identity threat detection and response (ITDR).

**Experience**

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

#### **The Role**

Addepar's Private Fund Look-Through (PFLT) offering gives clients deep visibility into the underlying holdings of their private fund investments by extracting holding-level data directly from GP financial statements—primarily the Schedule of Investments (SOI). This white-glove solution combines proprietary AI/ML extraction technology with human-in-the-loop review to ensure maximum accuracy and full portfolio transparency.

As part of the broader Addepar Data organization, the **PFLT Data Operations Team Lead** is responsible for managing a team of Analysts and Senior Analysts focused on reviewing, validating, and enriching complex fund holding data within target SLAs. This role acts as a domain subject matter expert, overseeing exception resolution, pipeline monitoring (Databricks, Retool, Monday.com), and data entity mapping. You will play a pivotal role in driving team performance metrics, leading ML model retraining initiatives, and collaborating across Product, Engineering, ML Operations, and Client Success teams.  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

#### **What You'll Do**

* Lead and manage a team of PFLT Analysts & Senior Analysts, driving effective work allocation, daily queue management (Monday.com), and SLA compliance across peak quarter-end processing periods.
* Track and drive key team performance metrics, including SLA compliance, processing accuracy, and throughput.
* Support operational workflows, playbooks, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for private fund Look-through processing.
* Identify opportunities for process optimization, standardization, and automation across the pipeline.

* Perform quality control reviews and high-level audits to assist the team in correcting improperly extracted or mapped holdings data.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for data quality discrepancies, pipeline failures, and complex mapping issues (SOAP UI, GSM Search, PitchBook).
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and AIP teams to enhance operational efficiency by identifying extraction errors, curating edge-case datasets for AI model retraining, and refining pipeline tooling and UI (Retool/Databricks).
* Engage directly with clients, GPs, and Fund Administrators to resolve technical data inquiries, document discrepancies, and reporting edge cases.

#### **Who You Are**

* Minimum 5+ years of experience in a relevant role and domain
* Minimum 2+ years of people Team leader experience
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, or a related field
* Experience in Private equity / Alternatives investment process
* Experience in the financial investment/advisory industry with strong knowledge of capital markets, middle/back-office operations systems, and preferably with experience dealing with Alternatives (Private/Draw-down) Funds reporting statements and data

* Coordinate seating arrangements, refreshments, and other meeting requirements.

* Coordinate basic audio-visual equipment requirements and report technical issues to the concerned team.
* Ensure meeting rooms are properly arranged after meetings.

* Support the distribution of internal communications, notices, and announcements.
* Coordinate with IT, Security, Housekeeping, and other support teams to ensure smooth office operations.

* Ensure timely distribution of correspondence to the concerned employees or departments.
* Arrange outgoing courier services and maintain dispatch registers.
* Track important shipments and follow up on delivery status where required.
* Maintain records of document receipts, acknowledgements, and dispatch details.
* Ensure that confidential documents are handled securely and delivered only to authorized recipients.
* Coordinate the collection and dispatch of documents requiring signatures or approvals.

G. Office Appearance, Housekeeping & Facilities Coordination

* Ensure the reception area, waiting area, and meeting spaces remain clean and professionally maintained.
* Coordinate with housekeeping staff for daily cleaning and upkeep.
* Monitor the availability of drinking water, visitor refreshments, and other basic reception amenities.
* Check the condition of reception furniture, visitor seating, signage, and office displays.
* Report facility-related issues and follow up with the concerned department for resolution.
* Ensure that company brochures, displays, and other front office materials are updated and presentable.
* Support the maintenance of a welcoming and professional office environment.

* Maintain accurate visitor logs and ensure that visitor passes are issued and collected according to company policy.
* Coordinate with security personnel for visitor clearance and employee access-related queries.
* Ensure confidential information, employee details, internal communications, and visitor records are protected.
* Avoid disclosing sensitive company information or employee contact details to unauthorized individuals.
* Immediately report suspicious activities, security concerns, unattended packages, or emergencies to the appropriate authority.
* Follow workplace safety procedures and support emergency response requirements as instructed.
* Maintain professional conduct and comply with company policies and administrative procedures.

I. General Administrative Support & Reporting

* Maintain daily visitor reports, call logs, courier registers, and meeting room utilization records.
* Prepare periodic front office and administrative reports as required.
* Maintain updated employee directories, contact lists, and departmental information.
* Assist with data entry, spreadsheet updates, document filing, and routine office correspondence.
